scope: Independent history question, not a semantic+graph combination claim
baseline: Exact matched 2-epoch B1 weighted-BCE 100% labeled condition from frozen E3; same tensors, optimizer, seeds, batch size and loss
selection: Fixed last epoch; all seeds and equal-probability ensemble; no K/epoch/mode search
training_graph: Only training nodes. No warmup nodes; no validation/test observations or outcomes
inference: Gather at most K strictly past same-user inputs for each target before the model call; unknown slots are zero placeholders, not masked future observations
limits: Single-hop single-head lightweight attention with explicit age decay and gate, NOT full TGAT reproduction
Mean pool is a lightweight last-K history baseline, not an order-aware RNN
No semantic-history combination unless formal E1 admission supports it
Two-epoch bounded budget, not exhaustive tuning
